changes.title: Quest handin
items: Bringing the creature a sleeping legend dreams of into its circle now finishes the quest, whether it's following you or parked nearby
The circle's panel names what the legend dreams of in words ("a young elk"), and tells you when the one you've brought is the wrong kind or age

changes.title: Map ring fill
items: The forest is laid out about a quarter faster as the game starts.

changes.title: Aggro sound
items: When a wild area's creatures stop and stare at you, a low warning rises until they attack, and falls away if you leave first
